verdict.rationale: Lock-in is a fair question for a 3D engine, and three.js is MIT-licensed open source per the npm registry probe. It also works with the open glTF format through GLTFLoader, so leaving carries little friction. However, the evidence shows no capability for exporting scenes or assets out to open formats; the editor is listed without any export details. Missing for 10: documented export to open formats (e.g. a glTF/OBJ exporter or editor export), evidence that a full scene or project round-trips, independent hands-on corroboration.
